roads.name: Summit Pass Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 26 in 2.8 miles, about 9 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 8,251 to 8,853 ft, with 954 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 74°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 25 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.15 g.
